en: Sepia-toned photograph of a historic multi‑storey building with steep gabled roofs and a prominent clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and slender spire. The structure resembles a small castle or manor house with several wings surrounding a courtyard. Trees, bushes and a dirt path occupy the foreground; laundry is hanging on a line at the left side. The card has scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No printed text is visible on the front.
